title: About BART
relevance: Current official system-facts source stating that BART operates in five counties with 131 miles of track and 50 stations and listing the current outer service points.
notes: Best concise official statement that Alameda County alone is too narrow.

title: BART Police
relevance: Current official police landing page stating the mission is to ensure a safe environment within the transit system and linking current police planning materials.
notes: Useful current source that frames the policing layer around the transit system rather than a county.

title: Know Your Zone
relevance: Current official police map page for BART police zones.
notes: Official mapping-oriented source that supports a systemwide police footprint.

title: BART Police Department Strategic Plan 2023-2027
relevance: Current official police PDF stating that BART PD provides service 24/7 for the district and describing the district as a 131-mile, 50-station system servicing five counties.

title: BART Police Department Report
relevance: Official police report stating that BART PD is the primary law-enforcement authority for the BART District's trackway, stations, and parking stalls spanning multiple counties.
notes: Best explicit property-scope wording, though it predates the Santa Clara extension.

title: California Penal Code Section 830.33
relevance: Official statute tying BART peace-officer authority to district-owned, operated, or administered property and to duties involving district patrons, employees, and properties.
notes: Core legal basis for rejecting countywide or placewide proxying.

title: California Public Utilities Code Section 99170
relevance: Official statute governing conduct on transit-district property and on facilities where BART owes policing responsibilities to a local government under interagency agreement.
notes: Important for the exact include/exclude boundary of a custom BART footprint.

title: 2024 FBI-derived BART roster rows
relevance: Local roster evidence showing separate Alameda, Contra Costa, San Francisco, and San Mateo BART ORIs, with multiple county-tagged rows sharing the same Oakland-area coordinate.
notes: Direct evidence that county tags are administrative slices, not separate local patrol geographies.

title: ORI validation and place-anchor evidence for BART rows
relevance: Local validation evidence showing repeated place_fips 53000 across multiple BART county-tagged rows and decoding 53000 as Oakland.
notes: Useful for showing why the Oakland anchor is an administrative heuristic rather than a defensible production place footprint.
